literal_statement: For every O∈O(d), the matrix A=OΛOᵀ satisfies I_d ≼ A ≼ κ I_d.

seven_slots.objects: A real finite-dimensional orthogonal matrix O; the source cosine grid θ_i and λ_i; diagonal Λ; rotated precision A.
seven_slots.domains: Integer d≥2; real κ≥2; source indices i=1,…,d; O∈O(d)⊂R^(d×d).
seven_slots.quantifiers: For each allowed d and κ, define the deterministic grid and Λ. For every orthogonal O, set A=OΛOᵀ and conclude the two bounds.
seven_slots.assumptions: d≥2 and κ≥2 are standing hard-family assumptions from S4.SS1.p1.1; orthogonality is the explicit lemma premise. The actual grid formulas define θ,λ,Λ,A.
seven_slots.conclusion: The two non-strict symmetric-matrix/Loewner inequalities I_d≼A≼κ I_d. Symmetry of A is internally obtained from the literal conjugated diagonal matrix.
seven_slots.scopes_senses: Deterministic pointwise in O. The Haar draw and seed independence define the randomized hard input but are not needed for this lemma. Euclidean geometry and real matrices follow S2.
seven_slots.constant_dependencies: No hidden constants. The source lower/upper numbers are exactly 1 and κ. Theorem 4.1’s δ,d0,q,ε and upper bound on κ are not lemma hypotheses.
